Uses FSR 3.1 to reconstruct the image. The game resolution is controlled separately by the resolution setting; turning FSR off does not disable the resolution patch.

Changes the game resolution through a patch. Available options follow the selected game and version and stay in sync with Patches. Native disables the resolution patch. Takes effect on the next launch.
60 is the game\'s original engine frame rate. Higher values require a matching game patch and only appear when available. This setting stays in sync with Patches and takes effect on the next launch.

No matching patch catalog. Check the game and update folders to enable resolution and engine frame rate settings. See Patches for details.

Tap a profile to apply its resolution, a 60 FPS target, and mobile graphics defaults. Disables SSAO, motion blur, depth of field, bloom, soft particles and dynamic shadows; enables intro skipping and X to skip videos. You can then adjust each setting here or in Patches. Experimental profiles: results depend on your phone. Changes take effect on the next launch.
Syncs the game\'s frames with your screen\'s refresh rate to stop visual tearing. Leave it ON unless you see tearing or stutter.
How many frames the game prepares ahead of what the screen shows. Lower numbers cut input lag; higher numbers can improve smoothness on weaker hardware.
Lets you move the camera freely around the world for exploring or testing, instead of following the gameplay camera. Meant for experimentation, not normal play.
Sharpens floors and walls viewed at an angle. Higher values may use a little more GPU bandwidth. Takes effect on the next launch.
Scales the gamepad vibration strength. 0% disables vibration. Takes effect immediately while the game is running.
Frame generation needs the Lossless.dll from your own copy of Lossless Scaling. Import the file here, or get it from Steam.
Beside your game folder — remove it there yourself
Imported files stay in the app\'s private folder and take effect the next time the game starts. IMPORT .DLL also works when Steam is unavailable.
God of War III for Android
A community launcher bringing the God of War III Remastered experience to Android via emulation.
Back up your God of War III saves to a .zip file, or restore a backup. The game\'s savedata lives in the app\'s private folder.
Importing replaces the current saves, but the existing ones are backed up first into the app\'s private folder.
Export the God of War III runtime logs to a .zip file for troubleshooting. The game\'s log (android-game.log) lives in the app\'s private folder.
Exporting only reads the runtime log files; it never modifies them or grabs the system logcat.
